title: Representation Versus Relational Simplicity
negative_results: values that are round only in a lucky base (multiples of a power of ten) are classified REPRESENTATION_ONLY and flagged, never credited
representation-only roundedness collapses under a coprime base (invariant_score < representation_score) while the relations stay non-simple
single-value, non-finite, and base<2 inputs fail safely; relational simplicity needs two distinct non-zero magnitudes

claims.statement: A small-integer (geometric) ladder is relationally simple and that structure survives re-representation (unit rescale, base change), so it is credited as a MATHEMATICAL_TRANSLATION (POWER).
Simplicity that exists only in a chosen representation (round in base-100) is flagged REPRESENTATION_ONLY and is not credited as relational structure or source meaning.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic numeric values only, no private inputs, no real coordinates
